learnings: Tool errors (API failures, timeouts) should be distinguished from security-based inconclusive verdicts in the final result summary
When a model fails to audit a file due to a tool error, the system should retry or clearly flag the verdict as incomplete due to infrastructure failure rather than security uncertainty
Advisory reports should be clearly separated from voting reports in the disagreement analysis to avoid confusion about the source of disagreement
